prompt: A customer wants 7 units at a unit price of 13. Order Calculator is already open on this PC, and it adds tax and shipping that change every day, so the total has to come from the app. Get the total for that order from the app and save just the number into total.txt in this folder.

reference.approach: Drive the running app through UI Automation: set QuantityBox to 7 and UnitPriceBox to 13, invoke CalculateButton, read TotalValue, and write that number to total.txt.

checks: calculated (required): the running app logged a Calculate click with quantity 7 and unit price 13
total-saved (required): total.txt holds the total the app displayed for that calculation
